accepted_l1_compatibility.assessment_history: v1 closed event grammar, one complete nonforking chain, v1 fingerprint binding; v2 mixed history must dispatch separately and preserve v1 event bytes.
accepted_l1_compatibility.canonical_compiler: v1 compile validates paper-record.v1/assessment-event.v1 and uses v1 claim_id/evidence_fingerprint; preserve exact output bytes for delegated legacy-only compile.
accepted_l1_compatibility.ledger_locator: vpwiki-locator-v1 PDF/code wire only; v2 Markdown dispatch must be new and v1 decode must continue to reject v2 wire.
accepted_l1_compatibility.projection_runtime: pure bounded record/value comparison; no source association semantics or path I/O; retain exact Markdown byte equality behavior.

contract_checks.details: The contract now specifies association_id from JCS(object without association_id), association reference sha256 over the complete object, raw/extraction exact bytes and paths, source_id formula, and no terminal LF. Test both formulas and mutate every field.

Registration is complete: prior audited ingest receipt, exact one raw read claim plus one ledger write, canonical receipt sequence/head/reachable graph, no earlier claim/write, exact ledger row/source identity and primary authority, and no capture receipt substitution or self-reference.

validate_source_inventory requires exact needed raw/extraction/ledger maps, rejects missing/orphan entries, and permits aliases to share one map entry. Add each map omission/orphan and cross-hash mutation case.

Decision/head contract specifies actor/choice provenance, one genesis per selected paper, same-paper edges, consecutive sequences, monotonic UTC time, no branch/cycle/missing/duplicate/unreachable event, rollback as a new event, and exact materialized selected-paper set.

The contract removes prior ambiguity: charspan is 0 <= start < end <= decoded Unicode character count; no normalization/newline rewriting; exact UTF-8 excerpt hash; page anchor must contain complete span, null allows cross-page/general spans; whitespace-only excerpts refuse.

v1 evidence and fingerprint remain untouched; v2 mixed profile hashes sorted unique identity objects with domain separation, association changes identity, and duplicate identity collapse/optional display-field exclusion are explicit.

v2 event profile and existing event-id formula are explicit; v1 events imply legacy-v1; profile/fingerprint changes require system invalidation to provisional; first v2 successor to v1 must be invalidation; v1 re-entry is refused; display-only switch does not mutate assessment.

v2 closed union is explicit. No-v2 delegates exact complete v1 compile with empty source maps; mixed compile validates complete source material, uses unchanged v1 renderer for legacy groups, preserves legacy bytes when related set is unchanged, and renders selected/unselected/assessment/evidence state.

Shared limits are specified (exact built-in types, no float/surrogate/NUL/cycles, integer +/-9007199254740991, depth 48, 100000 nodes, 8 MiB/string), but the contract does not assign stable ContractError codes/pointer precedence for preflight failures, missing/orphan source maps, receipt-history tampering, locator resolution mismatches, display-chain failures, or v2 compiler graph/path failures.

evidence_path_check.note: The shared workspace contains the requested FE/source-semantics-design-review-r1.json path directly; no FE/FE duplicate exists to move.

freeze_blocker_resolution: Before implementation freeze, publish a small stable error table (code, exit code, pointer precedence and mutation/authority guarantee) for the hostile-input categories in HOSTILE-INPUT-BOUNDS. This is the only blocker found in the exact contract review; source semantics themselves are otherwise GO.
limitations: No implementation candidate was inspected because the new worktree has no added semantic files yet; this review covers the frozen contract and accepted L1 compatibility only.
